name: nifty-weekly-condor-16d
title: NIFTY weekly iron condor, 16 delta with 100-point wings
description: Sell the 16-delta call and put of the next NIFTY weekly expiry 6 calendar days before it and buy wings 100 points beyond each: defined risk. Take profit at half the credit, stop at twice the credit (at the close), else cash settlement.
references: The 16-delta strangle and managing winners at 50% are practitioner habits, not evidence: this spec tests them on NSE data
